title: Choose the visual world
question: Quieter pass. Keep the pressed leaf, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Pressed leaf
options.lineage: One specimen on a blank page
options.thesis: One place, one fact, a lot of empty paper. Age is how faint the leaf has become.
options.viewport: ProxiPrompt as a nearly blank page. The place name is a small caption. The question is the only line you can write.
options.risk: So quiet that a new prompt is easy to miss.

options.label: Botanical plate
options.lineage: A folio that follows one plant through the year
options.thesis: Fresh, aging, and gone are seasons of the same place, drawn at one scale.
options.case: Makes evidence age visible without badges. Five plates is more furniture than you asked for.
options.viewport: A single plate. The place is the specimen. The ask sits in the caption.
options.risk: Starts to feel like a nature book instead of a question.

options.label: Graphite panels
options.thesis: Panels stay put. One accent. Destructive actions sit alone.
options.case: Fuses poorly. Hairline seams and a dark console are the sharp system this pass was meant to leave.
options.viewport: A dark panel with the ask in one well and the list in another.

options.label: Poster wall
options.lineage: A streaming row of title cards
options.thesis: Each place is a tile. The one you are on grows. The rest step back.
options.case: Fuses poorly. A wall of pictures fights both the empty page and the request to avoid generated images.
options.viewport: Horizontal rows of place tiles, one expanded.
options.risk: Becomes a gallery instead of a question.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark composer, a feed of cards, and a bottom tab bar, played straight.
canonCard.viewport: ProxiPrompt name, a question box, then a scroll of place cards.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other campus app.
